dedupe_keys.name: ai4mobile industrial wireless datasets iv2v and iv2i

description: AI4Mobile publishes measurements for industrial vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-infrastructure communications. The iV2V experiment covers roughly ten hours with three automated guided vehicles; iV2I+ covers roughly sixteen hours with a cleaning robot on a private cellular network. Fraunhofer HHI and collaborators provide combined Parquet tables, source tables and original logs, with feature metadata and Python examples on GitHub. Coverage comprises two industrial testbeds, not a geographic network survey. iV2V packets are spaced about 20 milliseconds apart and vehicle positions about 50 milliseconds. The combined iV2I+ table is resampled to one second, while original radio and robot measurements have finer intervals. DataCite states CC BY 4.0 for the data. IEEE DataPort exposes metadata publicly and states that a free IEEE account is needed for file access; payload access was not attempted. A limitation is that resampling loses information and interrupted clock synchronisation can affect packet-delay measurements by several milliseconds. Simulation uses include radio-quality, link-selection and robot communication validation alongside platform-ns-3, without a verified direct import path. The repository describes LTE channels; a blanket 5G claim is not adopted.
name: AI4Mobile industrial wireless datasets: iV2V and iV2I+
